job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.description: The Senior Software Engineer at Order.co designs complex features end-to-end, mentors junior engineers, and participates in design reviews while ensuring quality and reliability of systems. Order.co is a guided B2B marketplace with a mission to simplify buying for businesses.
responsibilities: Design and implement complex features end-to-end
Own subsystems and navigate existing codebases with architectural discernment using AI tooling as an accelerant
Participate in design reviews and propose sound technical designs
Scope and estimate accurately; deliver features from requirements through rollout and post-release monitoring
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews and pairing
Drive improvements in team practices — testing patterns, observability, code organization
Explain technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

positioning: Prioritize bullets showing ownership, reliability, and cross-functional delivery impact.
project_suggestions: Highlight projects touching CI/CD, Observability, query performance
gap_analysis: Add quantified outcomes (latency, uptime, delivery speed, or cost savings) where possible.
